items.title: 4.1.8.4 Types of Graphs; Graph Implementation Using Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of graphs (PDF 114-116).

blocks.text: Graphs ko un ki banawat aur properties ke hisab se kai qismon mein baanta jata hai. Main qismein directed, undirected aur weighted hain. Har qisam saada misalon se achhi tarah samajh aati hai.

items: Directed graph: is mein edges ki direction (simt) hoti hai, yaani edge ek vertex se doosre vertex ki taraf ek khaas taraf jati hai, jaisa Figure 4.11 mein teer (arrows) dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch neele dairon A se E ka directed graph, weight wale teeron ke saath: B se A (10), A se C (12), C se B (20), E se A (7), A se D (60) aur C se D (32).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.11: Directed weighted graph (kitab ki Figure 4.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Misal: Figure 4.11 dekhein. Shehar A se shehar B jana ho to sirf usi taraf ja sakte hain jis ki sign ijazat de. Agar A se B ki taraf one-way sarak nahi to A se seedha B nahi ja sakte. (Figure mein teer B se A ki taraf hai, A se B ki taraf nahi.)

items: Undirected graph: is mein edges ki koi direction nahi; agar do vertices jure hain to dono taraf aa ja sakte hain.

blocks.text: Misal: Figure 4.12 mein agar Person A, Person B ka dost hai to Person B bhi Person A ka dost hai. Dosti ki koi ek taraf nahi, is liye doston ke beech dono taraf aa ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch dairon A, B, C, D aur E ka undirected graph, saada lakeeron se jura: A-B, A-E, B-E, B-D, B-C, C-D aur E-D.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.12: Undirected graph (kitab ki Figure 4.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Weighted graph: is mein har edge ka ek weight ya cost hota hai, jo ek vertex se doosre tak jane ka faasla, waqt ya kharcha batata hai, jaise Figure 4.11 mein teeron par likhe numbers.

blocks.text: Misal: shehar ka map (naqsha) sochiye jis mein har sarak ka faasla ya safar ka waqt alag hai. Ek jagah se doosri jagah jane ke liye map har sarak ka faasla ya waqt batata hai, jis se sab se chhota ya sab se tez raasta maloom hota hai.
Python mein graphs NetworkX jaisi libraries (pehle se likha hua tayyar code) se banaye ja sakte hain. Saada misal:

import networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Create a graph object
G = nx.Graph()
# Add vertices (nodes)
G.add_node('A')
G.add_node('B')
G.add_node('C')
# Add edges (links) between vertices
G.add_edge('A', 'B')
G.add_edge('B', 'C')
# Draw the graph
nx.draw(G, with_labels=True)
plt.show()
blocks.caption: Sahi code

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import networkx as nx": NetworkX library (graph banane ka tayyar code) laata hai aur use chhota naam nx deta hai.
"import matplotlib.pyplot as plt": Matplotlib ka pyplot hissa, jo tasveer (drawing) dikhata hai, naam plt.
"G = nx.Graph()": ek khali undirected graph banta hai.
"G.add_node('A')" (aur B, C): teen vertices (nodes) jorte hain.
"G.add_edge('A', 'B')" aur "G.add_edge('B', 'C')": A-B aur B-C ke beech edges (links).
"nx.draw(G, with_labels=True)": graph ki drawing banata hai; with_labels=True se har node par us ka naam likha aata hai.
"plt.show()": drawing ko alag window mein dikhata hai.
Is program ka output text nahi balke ek tasveer hai: teen gol nodes A, B, C aur do lakeerein A-B aur B-C. Yeh sirf us computer par chalega jahan networkx aur matplotlib install hon (pip install networkx matplotlib); browser mein yeh nahi chalta, is liye is par Run button nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein nodes ke naam tirchhe quotes ’ ’ mein hain (maslan ’ A ’), jinhein Python nahi maanta, is liye SyntaxError aata hai. Naamon ke andar spaces bhi hain; agar seedhe quotes ke saath ' A ' aur 'A' likha jaye to yeh do alag nodes ban jate hain. Upar seedhe quotes aur bina space ke naam hain. Kitab ne matplotlib.pyplot ko pit naam diya hai; yeh chal jata hai kyunke dono jagah pit hai, magar aam taur par plt likhte hain. (Yeh code chalane ke liye networkx aur matplotlib install hone chahiyein.)

items: Pehle graph object banaya jata hai: G = nx.Graph().
Nodes 'A', 'B' aur 'C' graph mein jore jate hain.
In nodes ko edges se jora jata hai: A-B aur B-C.
Graph Matplotlib se bana kar screen par dikhaya jata hai.

blocks.text: Yeh misal teen nodes aur do edges wala saada graph dikhati hai, aur batati hai ke program mein vertices aur edges kaise likhe jate hain.

Upar wala NetworkX code browser mein nahi chalta, is liye yahan graph ko saada dictionary se likha gaya hai: roads mein Figure 4.11 ki har one-way edge ka weight hai. path badal kar Run karein, maslan ["E", "A", "D"], aur raaste ka total weight (cost) dekhein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"roads = {...}": Figure 4.11 ki har one-way edge aur us ka weight (cost). "B-A": 10 ka matlab B se A jane ka kharcha 10.
"path = ["E", "A", "C", "D"]": jis raaste ka kharcha nikalna hai.
"cost, possible = 0, True": shuru mein kharcha 0, aur maan lete hain ke raasta mumkin hai.
"for i in range(len(path) - 1):": path ke har do lagataar vertices ka joda (E-A, A-C, C-D).
"road = path[i] + "-" + path[i + 1]": joda "E-A" jaisi string banata hai.
"if road in roads: ...": yeh one-way road maujood hai to us ka weight cost mein jorta hai aur chhapta hai.
"else: ... possible = False": road nahi (ya ulti taraf hai) to message aur raasta na-mumkin.
"if possible:": raasta poora mumkin ho to kul cost chhapta hai.
Output: "E-A costs 7", "A-C costs 12", "C-D costs 32", aur "Total cost of E-A-C-D = 51".
Khud try karein: path = ["E", "A", "D"] kar ke Run karein: "Total cost of E-A-D = 67" aayega, jo 51 se mehnga hai. path = ["E", "D"] par "No one-way road E-D" aayega aur total nahi chhapega.

blocks.prompt: Directed weighted graph (B se A 10, A se C 12, C se B 20, A se D 60, C se D 32, E se A 7) mein E se D tak sab se sasta raasta kaunsa hai?
blocks.explanation: E se A se C se D: 7 + 12 + 32 = 51. Yeh E se A se D (7 + 60 = 67) se sasta hai.

items: Graph ki qismein: directed (ek taraf), undirected (dono taraf), weighted (har edge ka weight).
